title: 10 Years Ago, Cartoon Network Debuted Its Most Controversial Reboot
content: Throughout its long history, Cartoon Network has been a major player in the world of animation. With the cable network creating critically acclaimed series, including Dexter’s Laboratory, Courage The Cowardly Dog, Ed Edd ‘n Eddy , and too many others to count, not every entry has been a winner with fans and critics…
author: ComicBook

title: Fairy Tail Returning With New Revival Series From Original Creator
content: Fairy Tail has announced it’s officially coming back with a brand new series with the original creator behind it all. Hiro Mashima’s Fairy Tail is one of the most popular action franchises of all time.
author: ComicBook

title: Gohoubi Launches New Kakuriki Manga
content: This year's 19th issue of Kodansha 's Weekly Young Magazine announced on Monday that Gohoubi will launch a new series Kakuriki in the magazine's next issue on April 13. The series follows former high-ranking sumo wrestler Daigo Senzen.
author: ANN

title: Dandadan Gets a New Adaptation Ahead of Season 3
content: The acclaimed Shonen Jump+ manga, Dandadan , by Yukinobu Tatsu, was released five years ago on April 6th, 2021. The series has come a long way since then and reached new heights of popularity thanks to the incredible adaptation by Science SARU.
author: ComicBook

title: Chako Abeno, Kitsune Tennoji, Nagato Yamada Launch New Manga Together
content: Kodansha 's Young Magazine Web announced last Wednesday that Chako Abeno , Kitsune Tennōji , and Nagato Yamata will launch a new series titled Academy Saikyo no Mob Healer ~Shi ni Ge Sekai no Mob ni Tenseishita Ore wa, Hazura Job (Healer) to Gensaku Chishiki de Musōsuru~ (The Academy's Strongest Mob Healer: I Was…
author: ANN

title: Universal Basic Guys Creators Talk Season 2 Finale, Season 3 Future, & More (Exclusive)
content: Universal Basic Guys has been one of the standout hits of Fox’s Animation Domination block for the past few years, and ComicBook got the chance to talk with its creators all about the end of their second season and renewal for the third.
author: ComicBook

title: One Piece: Netflix Announces New Animated Special
content: Today has been a major day for the One Piece franchise, as Netflix has dropped some significant info bombs regarding the Straw Hat Pirates. To start, the streaming service confirmed that the live-action adaptation would return next year, running with the title of One Piece: The Battle of Alabasta .
author: ComicBook

title: Muse Reveals Spring 2026 Anime Line-Up
content: Muse’s Spring 2026 anime line-up has officially been released, featuring a fresh wave of highly anticipated titles packed with action, fantasy, drama, and heartwarming moments that anime fans across the Philippines and Asia will surely enjoy.
author: Anime Corner

title: This Anime Game Is About to Deliver What I Have Wanted for Years
content: There is no shortage of anime games, but they face a unique challenge that other games do not. They need to balance fan service with gameplay systems that stand on their own. Some succeed by recreating iconic moments, while others try to expand on their source material with original stories.
author: ComicBook

title: Shonen Jump’s Most Controversial Series Is Getting a Surprise Revival
content: One of the most controversial series to ever end with Shuesha’s Weekly Shonen Jump magazine is coming back with a surprising new project that’s going to bring it to an entirely new medium.
